adminMoney.title: Money
adminMoney.how: Money module console (M0). Vinko only stores references: a licensed provider runs the pool and no one's balances live here. Everything is off by default: every country in "points only", no pools and the kill switch at hand. None of this appears in public.
adminMoney.envHint: misc.env in remote_config. The mock provider is only allowed outside "production".
adminMoney.pendingMigration: Migration 0045 (money) still needs to be applied.
adminMoney.killSwitchHint: With the kill switch on, no pools or entries are created in any country, even if the country is enabled.
adminMoney.p2pOn: On · people can create and join porras with money
adminMoney.p2pHint: Turns on creating and joining porras with money inside groups (18+ only, money goes straight between people and Vinko never touches it). Porras already under way can still be resolved and paid even when off.
adminMoney.countriesHint: A country only shows money if it is enabled, in provider or own mode, with legal basis and provider. Today all are points only.
adminMoney.cfg.title: Per-country configuration
adminMoney.cfg.how: The only write path for remote_config.money.countries. Enabling a country requires a mode other than "points only", legal basis with date, provider, domain, currency and self-exclusion registry. Fields not shown here (payment methods, notes) are kept as they are.
adminMoney.cfg.pick: Pick a country from the list to edit it, or type a new ISO code.
adminMoney.cfg.providerHint: mock (outside production only), partner_<name> or vinko_money.
adminMoney.cfg.badCountry: The country must be a two-letter ISO code.
adminMoney.cfg.badStakes: Entries must be positive integers separated by commas.
adminMoney.pools.title: Pools and official source
adminMoney.pools.how: Order: 1) add the official results source, 2) assign it to an editorial porra (it becomes eligible), 3) attach the pool with the provider, 4) set the result from the source and settle. The human judge never decides a porra with a pool: only the official source does.
adminMoney.feed.title: Official results source
adminMoney.feed.how: In M0 it is filled by hand with the official record and its URL. The key has the format provider:sport:event (lowercase and underscores; the event allows uppercase and hyphens).
adminMoney.feed.label: Label
adminMoney.feed.badForm: Check provider, label, date and number of options (2–6).
adminMoney.feed.empty: No official sources yet. Without a source, no porra can carry a pool.
adminMoney.editorial.title: Open editorial porras
adminMoney.editorial.how: Only editorial, public and open porras. Assigning a source with the same number of options makes the porra eligible for a pool. Removing the source is only possible if it has no pool.
adminMoney.editorial.sourceSet: Source assigned: the porra is now eligible.
adminMoney.attach.title: Attach pool
adminMoney.attach.how: Creates the pool at the provider and stores only its reference. Enabled country with legal basis; the entry comes from the country's allowed entries and the fee from the default value.
adminMoney.attach.noCountries: No country enabled with legal basis. Configure it first under Countries.
adminMoney.attach.noStakes: The country has no allowed entries configured.
adminMoney.attach.noPorras: No eligible porras without a pool.
adminMoney.attach.badForm: Check country, entry and fee (0–2000 basis points).
adminMoney.list.title: Pools
adminMoney.act.settleHint: Requires a result set in the official source. The status changes when the provider confirms via webhook.
adminMoney.act.settleSent: Settlement accepted by the provider; the status will change when the webhook arrives.
adminMoney.events.title: Provider events
adminMoney.events.how: Latest 100 verified webhooks (idempotent by event_id). Those that failed on data can be retried; duplicates are ignored.
adminMoney.err.pending_migration: Migration 0045 (money) still needs to be applied.
adminMoney.err.bad_stake: The entry is not among the country's allowed entries.
adminMoney.err.country_off: Country not enabled or without legal basis.
adminMoney.err.provider_unavailable: Provider unavailable (no mock in production; configure the country's provider).
adminMoney.err.provider_rejected: The provider rejected the operation; the status does not change.
adminMoney.err.no_result: The official source has no result yet.
adminMoney.err.bad_status: The pool is not in a status that allows that action.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_SERVICE_ONLY: Only the service can apply events.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_AFFILIATE_NO_: Enabled affiliation needs a legal basis.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_ALREADY_IN: The user already has an entry in that pool.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_BAD_RESULT: Invalid result: that option does not exist in the source.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_CLOSE_AFTER_P: The pool close cannot be later than the porra's.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_ENABLED_NEEDS: To enable a country the mode cannot be "points only".
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_GEO_MISMATCH: The user's declared country does not match the pool's.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_HAS_POOL: The porra already has a pool: the source cannot be removed.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_KILL_SWITCH: Kill switch on: all money is off.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_MOCK_IN_PROD: The mock provider is not allowed in production.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_NOT_CATALOG: Only editorial, public and non-template porras can be eligible.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: The porra is not eligible for a pool.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_NO_LEGAL_BASI: The legal basis is missing (or does not match the configured one).
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_NO_LEGAL_DATE: The date the legal basis is valid from is missing.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_NO_SOURCE: The official results source is missing.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_NO_WITHDRAW: That country does not allow withdrawing before close.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_OPTIONS_MISMA: The source's number of options does not match the porra's.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_PROVIDER_MISM: The pool's provider does not match the country's.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_RESULT_REQUIR: A porra with a pool is only resolved with the official source's result.
adminMoney.err.VINKO_MONEY_USER_NOT_ALLO: User not allowed (guest, deleted or suspicious).
adminMoney.rev.title: Operator rev-share
adminMoney.rev.intro: The commission (rake) is charged by the licensed operator, who settles your share (B2B). This records what they pay you; it never moves the pot or charges cards.
adminMoney.rev.none: No settlements yet. They appear when an operator pays you the rev-share.
